Transcriber — notices for third-party components

WHISPER.NET
Whisper.net and its native runtime packages are distributed under the MIT License.
Project: https://github.com/sandrohanea/whisper.net
The full MIT license is included as whisper.net-LICENSE.txt.

NAUDIO
NAudio is distributed under the MIT License.
Project: https://github.com/naudio/NAudio
The full MIT license is included as naudio-LICENSE.txt.

FFMPEG
This installer includes the Windows x64 shared LGPL build FFmpeg n9.0.2-31-gc89d6ee1ca
from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds. FFmpeg is a separate executable and communicates with
Transcriber through command-line arguments and WAV files.
Builds: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
FFmpeg source at the corresponding revision: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/gc89d6ee1ca
The LGPL license text is included as FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt. The shared FFmpeg libraries
are replaceable independently of Transcriber.

MICROSOFT .NET
The self-contained package includes Microsoft .NET 8 runtime components.
Microsoft license and third-party notices are included as dotnet-LICENSE.txt and
dotnet-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
